route.instructions: Choose the route whose complete conditions match these facts. Evaluate episode and budgets first, evidence next, opponent motion next, then the action prerequisites. Missing evidence never permits action.

criteria.wait: Episode ACTIVE, budgets AVAILABLE, evidence FRESH AND COMPLETE, no contradiction, opponent MOVING, and hold branch AVAILABLE. Hold current pose for a bounded interval.
criteria.observe: Episode ACTIVE and budgets AVAILABLE, but evidence is stale, incomplete or contradictory; OR opponent motion is UNKNOWN; OR player turn or empty destination is not confirmed when opponent is stopped; OR the required branch is unavailable. Return to visual planner.
criteria.act: Episode ACTIVE, budgets AVAILABLE, evidence FRESH AND COMPLETE, no contradiction, opponent STOPPED, player turn CONFIRMED, empty destination CONFIRMED, action branch AVAILABLE. Every condition is required.
criteria.stop: Episode ENDED OR a budget EXHAUSTED. This overrides every other condition, even if all action conditions are satisfied.
